name: lockruf
description: LOCKRUF – 3D-Horrorspiel im Stil von Fears to Fathom (Three.js), Browser, Handy und Windows-App

scripts.app: node build.mjs --min --embed && node app/prepare.mjs && cd app && npm install && npx electron .
scripts.app:pack: node build.mjs --min --embed && node app/prepare.mjs && cd app && npm install && npx @electron/packager . LOCKRUF --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=../release --overwrite
scripts.deploy: git subtree push --prefix docs origin gh-pages
